test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a code language, 'ELEMENT' is written as ‘5, 12, 5, 13, 5, 14, 20’ and ‘ALLOY’ is written as ‘1, 12, 12, 15, 25’. How will ' VIBRANIUM' be written in that language?
solution:
**Explanation:**

The positional value table is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/889ff2be8a048327f450a975a401b2f4241e5f28d86896613386ad4014cb4505.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

Code = Positional values of every letter.

 
• ELEMENT → 5, 12, 5, 13, 5, 14, 20 

 
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1a779620d84031f9b36de0f4e7fa0e0aa49ed0526f040d6dc8e1faeb7202219c.png] 
 
• Code = 5, 12, 5, 13, 5, 14, 20
 
 

 

 
• ALLOY → 1, 12, 12, 15, 25 

 
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/312b9ef03ccc088bd4c518887405193bc32a1beadde455c14f54f972ac8da06f.png] 
 
• Code = 1, 12, 12, 15, 25
 
 

 

 
• Similarly, VIBRANIUM → ?

 
 
• ​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b657fa1195f82986e2b40ec26eebde4e75181ef523b424408eda16d515f0f139.png] ​​
 
• Code = 22, 9, 2, 18, 1, 14, 9, 21, 13
 
 

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.

d4:T
